title: Zainab ke labo par tha nouha Aye mere baradar aajao
body:
ZAINAB KE LABON PAR THA NAUHA – AYE MERE BARADER AAJAO
<<MINI>>
AAJAO SHABIHE SHER-E-KHUDA – AYE MERE BARADER AAJAO
<<DIVIDER>>
Farzand-e-Nabi ghode se gira, Hilti hai zameen-e-karbobala
Ab koi nahi Abid ke siwa
<<MINI>>
Aajao Shabihe Shere Khuda, Aye mere baradar aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai zaqm hazaron ek tan mein, Hai zeen-o-zameen khali ran mein
Teeron pa mulaaq hai lasha
<<MINI>>
Aajao Shabihe Shere Khuda, Aye mere baradar aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim bhi nahi Asghar bhi nahi, Saya bhi nahi hai ghar bhi nahi
Masnad bhi jali jhula bhi jala
<<MINI>>
Aajao Shabihe Shere Khuda, Aye mere baradar aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
Garmi se jhulaste hain bache, Khaimon mein bhadakte hain shole
Hai unke labon par walaila
<<MINI>>
Aajao Shabihe Shere Khuda, Aye mere baradar aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
Furqat mein teri nazon ki pali, Masoom Sakina hai roti
Gouhar bhi chine kurta bhi jala
<<MINI>>
Aajao Shabihe Shere Khuda, Aye mere baradar aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
Sarwar bhi nahi Akber bhi nahi, Ab sar pa mere chadar bhi nahi
Be parda khadi hai Aale aba
<<MINI>>
Aajao Shabihe Shere Khuda, Aye mere baradar aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
Be parda khadi hai teri bahen, Bazu mein bandhi hai uske rasan
Bewon ko satate hai aada
<<MINI>>
Aajao Shabihe Shere Khuda, Aye mere baradar aajao
<<DIVIDER>>
Begour-o-kafan reti pe pade, Mazhar the gharebon ke lashe
Zainab ke labon par thi ye sada
<<MINI>>
Aajao Shabihe Shere Khuda, Aye mere baradar aajao
